reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rule's preferred position is 'no non-solicit on Customer'; absence of any solicitation/no-hire/inducement covenant satisfies that position.

The cited paragraph (p0066) is a pure independent-contractor/no-agency clause containing no restrictive covenant, and the rationale documents targeted searches ('solicit', 'hire', 'employ', 'induce', 'recruit', plus a regex) returning no non-solicit language.
No redline and no counterparty comment are expected for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original text, which is correct here.

The failed deterministic sub-checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are non-probative because they presuppose an existing non-solicit; treating them as inapplicable is correct rather than evidence of a deviation.

Rationale correctly preserves the fallback position (mutual, personnel directly involved, 12 months, general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no no-hire) as the negotiating stance if the counterparty later introduces such a covenant.
